title: Third Taiwan Strait Crisis
description: China conducts missile tests near Taiwan, leading to the deployment of two US aircraft carrier groups to the region.

title: India Nuclear Tests (Pokhran-II)
description: India conducts a series of nuclear bomb test explosions, prompting international sanctions.

title: US Embassy Bombings
description: Al-Qaeda bombings of US embassies in Kenya and Tanzania.

title: Operation Desert Fox
description: US and UK launch a four-day bombing campaign on Iraqi targets.

title: NATO 1999 Enlargement
description: Hungary, Poland, and the Czech Republic join NATO.

title: NATO Bombing of Yugoslavia
description: NATO begins airstrikes against Yugoslavia during the Kosovo War.

title: Kargil War
description: Armed conflict between India and Pakistan in Kashmir.

title: Second Intifada Begins
description: Intensified Israeli-Palestinian violence begins.

title: USS Cole Bombing
description: Terrorist attack by al-Qaeda against the USS Cole in Yemen.

title: September 11 Attacks
description: Coordinated terrorist attacks by al-Qaeda on the United States.

title: US Invasion of Afghanistan
description: US and allied forces begin military operations in Afghanistan.

title: US Invasion of Iraq
description: US-led coalition invades Iraq to overthrow Saddam Hussein.

title: Madrid Train Bombings
description: Bombings against commuter trains in Madrid.

title: NATO 2004 Enlargement
description: Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia, and Slovenia join NATO.

title: London Transit Bombings
description: Coordinated terrorist attacks in London.

title: 2006 Lebanon War
description: Military conflict between Hezbollah and Israel.

title: North Korea First Nuclear Test
description: North Korea conducts its first nuclear weapon test.

title: Cyberattacks on Estonia
description: Massive cyberattacks target Estonian critical infrastructure, widely attributed to Russia.

title: Operation Orchard
description: Israeli airstrike destroys a suspected nuclear reactor in Syria.

title: Russo-Georgian War
description: War between Georgia and Russia over South Ossetia and Abkhazia.

title: Sinking of the ROKS Cheonan
description: South Korean navy ship torpedoed by a North Korean submarine.

title: Stuxnet Discovered
description: A malicious computer worm, suspected to be US-Israeli, ruins Iranian nuclear centrifuges.

title: Arab Spring Begins
description: Protests in Tunisia spark a wave of revolutions and civil wars across the Arab world.

title: Syrian Civil War Begins
description: Protests evolve into armed rebellion against the Assad government.

title: Military Intervention in Libya
description: NATO-led coalition begins military intervention in Libya.

title: Assassination of Osama bin Laden
description: US forces kill the founder of al-Qaeda in Pakistan.

title: EU Embargo on Iranian Oil
description: The EU adopts sanctions against Iran, including an oil embargo.

title: Benghazi Attack
description: Militants attack the US diplomatic compound in Benghazi, Libya.

title: Russian Annexation of Crimea
description: Russia invades and annexes the Crimean Peninsula from Ukraine. Leads to Western sanctions.

title: ISIS Northern Iraq Offensive
description: Islamic State forces launch a major offensive in Iraq, capturing Mosul.

title: Saudi-led Intervention in Yemen
description: Coalition led by Saudi Arabia launches military operations in Yemen.

title: November 2015 Paris Attacks
description: Coordinated terrorist attacks in Paris by ISIS.

title: Turkish Coup d'état Attempt
description: Faction within the Turkish military attempts to seize the government.

title: Shayrat Missile Strike
description: US launches Tomahawk missiles at Shayrat Airbase in Syria.

title: WannaCry Ransomware Attack
description: Global cyberattack attributed to North Korea disrupts global systems.

title: North Korea Sixth Nuclear Test
description: North Korea conducts a powerful nuclear test, severely escalating US tensions.

title: US Withdrawal from JCPOA
description: US unilaterally withdraws from the Iran Nuclear Deal and reinstates heavy sanctions.

title: Assassination of Jamal Khashoggi
description: Saudi journalist assassinated at the Saudi consulate in Istanbul.

title: Balakot Airstrike
description: Indian warplanes bomb alleged terrorist camps in Pakistan, causing a major border standoff.

title: Abqaiq-Khurais Attack
description: Drone attacks on Saudi Aramco oil facilities, disrupting 5% of global oil supply.

title: Assassination of Qasem Soleimani
description: US drone strike kills Iranian major general Qasem Soleimani in Baghdad.

title: Galwan Valley Skirmish
description: Deadly hand-to-hand clashes between Indian and Chinese troops.

title: SolarWinds Cyberattack Discovered
description: Massive cyber espionage campaign attributed to Russia affects thousands of global organizations and US government agencies.

title: Fall of Kabul
description: Taliban captures Kabul as US forces withdraw from Afghanistan.

title: Russian Invasion of Ukraine
description: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, causing massive global sanctions and market shocks.

title: Pelosi Visit to Taiwan
description: US House Speaker visits Taiwan, prompting massive Chinese military drills encircling the island.

title: Nord Stream Pipeline Sabotage
description: Bombings damage the Nord Stream 1 and 2 natural gas pipelines in the Baltic Sea.

title: NATO 2023 Enlargement
description: Finland officially joins NATO, doubling the alliance's border with Russia.

title: Hamas Attack on Israel
description: Hamas launches coordinated assault on Israel, triggering the Israel-Hamas War.

title: Houthi Red Sea Attacks Begin
description: Houthi movement begins attacking commercial shipping in the Red Sea.

title: Iran-Pakistan Border Skirmishes
description: Iran and Pakistan exchange missile strikes against alleged militant bases in each other's territory.

title: NATO 2024 Enlargement
description: Sweden officially joins NATO.

title: Iranian Strikes on Israel
description: Iran launches hundreds of drones and missiles directly at Israel in retaliation.
